lesson.summary:
Untuk menanyakan sudah berapa lama sesuatu berlangsung sampai sekarang, pakai *How long* + present perfect. Untuk aktivitas, bentuk continuous paling umum: *How long have you been studying Indonesian?* Untuk kata kerja keadaan (*know, have, be, like*), pakai bentuk simple: *How long have you known Dinda? How long have you had your car?*

Penutur Indonesia sering memakai bentuk sekarang (*How long are you here?*). Bentuk *Are you* hanya menanyakan keadaan sekarang. Kalau yang ditanyakan durasi sampai sekarang, pakai *have you been*: *How long have you been here?*

Untuk *live* dan *work*, bentuk simple dan continuous sama-sama benar: *She has lived / has been living in Malang since 2017.*

Kalimat negatif dengan *since* atau *for* biasanya memakai present perfect simple: *I haven't seen my grandparents for months. I haven't eaten since breakfast.*

patterns.formula: How long + have/has + subjek + been + V-ing … ?
patterns.example: How long have you been learning to drive?
How long have you known her?

patterns.formula: How long + have/has + subjek + been + tempat/keadaan?
patterns.example: How long have you been in Jakarta?
I haven't seen him since March.

examples.en: How long have you had your car?
examples.id: Sudah berapa lama kamu punya mobil itu?

examples.en: Fajar is in hospital. He's been there since Sunday.
examples.id: Fajar dirawat di rumah sakit. Dia sudah di sana sejak hari Minggu.

examples.en: How long have you been studying Indonesian? – For about a year.
examples.id: Sudah berapa lama kamu belajar bahasa Indonesia? – Sekitar setahun.

examples.en: They've been married for twenty years.
examples.id: Mereka sudah menikah selama dua puluh tahun.

examples.en: She has lived in Malang since 2017.
examples.id: Dia sudah tinggal di Malang sejak 2017.

examples.en: I haven't seen my grandparents for months. I should visit them.
examples.id: Sudah berbulan-bulan saya tidak bertemu kakek-nenek. Saya harus mengunjungi mereka.

commonMistakes.wrong: I know her for five years.
commonMistakes.right: I've known her for five years.
commonMistakes.why: Durasi sampai sekarang memakai present perfect, walaupun bahasa Indonesianya cukup "kenal".

commonMistakes.wrong: How long are you in Jakarta?
commonMistakes.right: How long have you been in Jakarta?
commonMistakes.why: *How long* sampai sekarang memakai *have you been*.

commonMistakes.wrong: He is working here since March.
commonMistakes.right: He has been working here since March.

questions.explanation: have (memiliki) adalah keadaan: How long have you had …?

questions.sentence: Fajar is in hospital. He {{1}} there since Sunday.
questions.explanation: Keadaan sampai sekarang: has been there since Sunday.

questions.sentence: How long {{1}} Indonesian? – For about a year.
questions.explanation: Aktivitas sampai sekarang: bentuk continuous paling umum, tetapi simple juga benar.

questions.sentence: I {{1}} my grandparents for months. I should visit them.
questions.explanation: Negatif dengan for: haven't + V3.
Keadaan menikah sampai sekarang: have been married.
live boleh simple atau continuous.
know adalah keadaan: How long have … known …?
Negatif dengan since: haven't + V3.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: I have known her for five years.
questions.explanation: Durasi sampai sekarang: have known.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: How long have you been in Jakarta? – Since May.
questions.explanation: Jawabannya Since May, jadi yang ditanyakan durasi sampai sekarang: have you been.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: He has been working here since March.
questions.explanation: since + titik awal: has been working (atau has worked).

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: We haven't seen each other since 2020.
questions.explanation: Setelah haven't perlu V3: seen.

questions.explanation: How long + have + you + had.

questions.hint: Saya sudah tinggal di sini sejak kecil.
questions.explanation: have lived + since + kalimat lampau.

questions.hint: Dia tidak menelepon saya selama seminggu.
questions.explanation: hasn't + V3 + for + durasi.

questions.explanation: How long + have + you + been + V-ing.

questions.sentence: Ana ___ in the same office for ten years.

options.why: Benar. Durasi sampai sekarang: present perfect.
for ten years sampai sekarang tidak dipakai dengan present continuous.
Present simple tidak menyatakan berapa lama sampai sekarang.

questions.explanation: Durasi sampai sekarang: have/has + V3 (atau been + V-ing).

options.why: Benar. have (memiliki) adalah keadaan, jadi pakai bentuk simple.
have dengan arti memiliki tidak dipakai dalam bentuk continuous.
Ini tidak menanyakan durasi sampai sekarang.

questions.explanation: Kata kerja keadaan: How long have you + V3?

questions.sentence: I'm learning to swim. – Oh, how long ___?

options.why: How long sampai sekarang tidak memakai present continuous.

questions.explanation: How long + have/has + been + V-ing.

options.why: Benar. Negatif dengan for: haven't + V3.
Present simple tidak menyatakan berapa lama sampai sekarang.
Present continuous tidak dipakai dengan for ages sampai sekarang.
